shouldFix.title: purpose calls the cumulative lands record unchanged while this v11 extends it by PLJ-V10-SF1
shouldFix.subjectText: Preserve the cumulative lands record unchanged; landing custody is recited per finding in findingDisposition and landsNote.
shouldFix.finding: The same purpose field opens 'Land PLJ-V10-SF1 on leftover-join.v10.'; authorityClaim says 'It lands PLJ-V10-SF1.'; lands[] grows from the six entries frozen in leftover-join.v9 and leftover-join.v10 to seven by appending PLJ-V10-SF1; findingDisposition adds a PLJ-V10-SF1 entry; landsNote says the record is 'carried from leftover-join.v9 and extended by this v11'. The sentence 'Preserve the cumulative lands record unchanged' is a byte-identical carry from leftover-join.v10 (where it was true because v10 landed nothing) and is contradicted in v11 by the lands array, by landsNote, by authorityClaim, and by the first sentence of purpose itself. It is exactly the attack the prompt names: 'purpose or any field calls a changed record unchanged'.

Different lineage; same wording class.

shouldFix.impact: No pin, no leftoverDesign member, no obligation standing, no currency conclusion, and no authority boundary changes. The machine-readable ledger (lands, findingDisposition, landsNote) is correct and complete. The defect is a stale prose recital in the field that is supposed to state what this version changes versus carries, and it flatly contradicts the bytes it describes.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The ledger is right and internally consistent everywhere except this one carried sentence; a reader of lands[], findingDisposition, and landsNote cannot be misled about custody. The subject binds NOTHING.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Issue and independently review a successor whose purpose states that the prior cumulative lands entries are carried unchanged and that the record is extended by PLJ-V10-SF1 (or equivalent unambiguous wording, e.g. 'Carry the six prior cumulative lands entries unchanged and extend the record by PLJ-V10-SF1; landing custody is recited per finding in findingDisposition and landsNote.'). Do not drop PLJ-V10-SF1, do not re-land any of the six prior findings, and change no pin, member, or standing. This review does not edit the subject.

decisionRule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. One SHOULD-FIX stands; REJECT.
